placements.why: Establishes an organizational strata for branch library operating schedules, access accommodations, and staffing policies distinct from tool library and transit operations.
placements.title: Branch library service hours and staffing management
placements.frame: How should branch library service schedules and staff allocations be structured to serve community access needs?

placements.title: Shifting operating hours to capture commuter returns while preserving flat staffing
placements.frame: How should branch library opening hours be shifted to accommodate commuter return traffic without expanding staffing requirements?
placements.why: Moira and Teo explain the policy of opening early at 08:00 on Tuesdays and Thursdays to facilitate book returns for commuters while offsetting with an earlier closure to maintain flat staffing.
